 Sudurpaschim Royals reach NPL final after beating Chitwan Rhinos 
 Nepal News 
 November 19, 2026 
 1 MIN READ 
 A 
 A+ 
 A- 
 content_copy 
 bookmark_border 
 KATHMANDU: The Sudurpaschim Royals have secured their spot in the final of the Nepal Premier League (NPL). In the second qualifier held at the TU Cricket Ground in Kirtipur on Thursday, the Royals defeated the Chitwan Rhinos by 3 wickets.
 Chasing a target of 134 runs, the Sudurpaschim Royals reached the goal in 19.5 overs, losing 7 wickets in the process. Tharindu Ratnayake top-scored for the winning side with 53 runs off 42 balls, hitting 7 fours. Additional contributions came from Binod Bhandari with 23 runs, Dipendra Singh Airee with 15, and Aarif Sheikh with 10. For Chitwan, Scott Kuggeleijn claimed 3 wickets, while Usama Mir, Rijan Dhakal, Kamal Airee, and Salauddin Khan each took 1 wicket.
 Earlier, after winning the toss and opting to bat, the Chitwan Rhinos posted a total of 133 runs for the loss of 9 wickets in their allotted 20 overs. Dawid Malan led the scoring for Chitwan with 71 runs, striking 9 fours and 2 sixes in his 51-ball innings. Salauddin Khan and Kamal Airee added 18 and 10 runs, respectively. On the bowling front for Sudurpaschim, Scott Kuggeleijn took 3 wickets, and Tharindu Ratnayake claimed 2. Hemant Dhami, Dipendra Singh Airee, and Ishan Pandey each contributed 1 wicket. The Royals will now face the Lumbini Lions in the final match of the tournament.
